title: Calculated Wounds
identity: Friedrich Hofmeister publishes Helge Jung’s Calculated Wounds, FH2407, for alto saxophone and piano. The publisher’s catalog assigns its own level marker 5. Retailer details say the saxophonist changes saxophones and the pianist uses a wooden stick and iron chain; those specific instructions were not checked against score pages.

evidence.claim: Hofmeister catalog lists Calculated Wounds FH2407 with a 5 marker.
Retailer record lists 69 pages, saxophone changes between saxophones, and piano preparation/instruments involving a wooden stick and iron chain.

review_focus: Review instrument changes, preparation instructions, stage logistics and score length directly in FH2407. The publisher’s 5 marker should be preserved as its own classification only.
collection_flag: Publisher catalog level marker 5; do not treat it as a SaxoBrain level. Work has nonstandard piano preparation and saxophone doubling according to a retailer listing.

score_links.description: Retailer listing, not a notation preview; specific preparation detail remains unverified against score.

gaps: Instrument-switching sequence and piano preparation details need primary-score confirmation.
